Multiple compression, gross profit per share, leverage change, debt maturities and governance remain typed unknown where unavailable.
FCF per share is an explicitly penalized proxy for historical owner-earnings change until prior SBC is reconciled.
Historical median exit multiple is unavailable; no-rerating IRR uses the lower of the current multiple and a configured conservative cap.
Price histories were observed retrospectively by ticker and are not strict-PIT eligible.
